examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The agent pauses to ask which environment to use: the reader picks an option and submits, or skips; the card then keeps the answer in the thread as text.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: The three answer controls: a choice between options, a one-line text answer, and a yes-or-no confirm whose buttons say what each answer does; every submit button names its outcome.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: The answer is being sent: the field is inert and Submit shows its loading state until the run takes the answer.
